mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that supports strong corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days. The interaction is critical because the signal is only strong when both indicators are rising.
failure_condition: The correlation between the joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) and positive 60-day returns is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 118.0), the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days. This mechanism is most active in the late phase of an economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 118.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for PAYEMS trend.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic growth and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days. The interaction is necessary because the signal is only strong when both indicators are positive.
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1 and HOUST both rising) does not produce positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the market prices in tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days. This mechanism is most active in the early stages of a monetary tightening cycle.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
